mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuthRequired removes the only constraint that pins unauthenticated operations to AuthFailure. The injection forces an unauth op with a non-AuthFailure outcome; F_PermissionEnforcement still bars Success (it needs a caller), so Alloy will pick e.g. ValidationError, which directly violates the AuthRequiredEverywhere assertion's strict equality to AuthFailure.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthRequiredViolation { some op: Operation | no op.opCaller and op.opOutcome != AuthFailure }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AppendOnly removes the constraint that every AuditEntry is produced by exactly one Operation. The injection forces an orphan audit row that no Operation claims, simulating either a fabricated entry or one whose originating op was deleted — exactly what append-only is supposed to prevent.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | all op: Operation | op.opAudit != ae }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_PermissionEnforcement removes the role/owner check on successful operations. The injection constructs a Member-role caller who successfully deletes a task they do not own (target.team matches header so F_CrossTeamIsolation is still satisfied). That is exactly the FR-009 violation the LeastPrivilege assertion must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some op: Operation, m: Membership | op.opOutcome = Success and op.opKind = DeleteTaskOp and m.mUser = op.opCaller and m.mTeam = op.opTeamHeader and m.mRole = Member and some op.opTarget and op.opTarget.taskTeam = op.opTeamHeader and op.opTarget.ownerUser != op.opCaller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_CrossTeamIsolation removes the constraint that a successful op's target must live in the caller's team. The injection forces a Success whose target is in another team while the caller is a legitimate member of their declared X-Team-Id team — the canonical cross-tenant leak that FR-014's byte-equivalent 404 is built to prevent.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamViolation { some op: Operation | op.opOutcome = Success and some op.opTarget and some op.opTeamHeader and op.opTarget.taskTeam != op.opTeamHeader and (some m: Membership | m.mUser = op.opCaller and m.mTeam = op.opTeamHeader) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_OwnerImmutable removes the constraint that PATCH bodies attempting to set owner_id are rejected. The injection forces a successful EditTask whose request body included an owner_id change — exactly the v1 immutability violation FR-006 must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnerImmutableViolation { some op: Operation | op.opKind = EditTask and op.opTriedSetOwner = True and op.opOutcome = Success }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditCompleteness removes the constraint that every successful mutating op writes exactly one audit row. The injection forces a successful EditTask with no associated audit entry — the missing-trail half of SC-007 that AuditCompleteness must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenessViolation { some op: Operation | op.opOutcome = Success and op.opKind = EditTask and no op.opAudit }
